properties.description: A hasStandardAlignment relationship connects a State standard to a CCSS standard when the two are supported by overlapping sets of Learning Components. The relationship indicates an evidence-based crosswalk derived from measurable overlap of deconstructed skills, expressed through properties such as jaccard and LC counts. It does not imply sequence, dependency, or pedagogical progression, only the degree of shared content between the two standards.
